description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pujanagaraya, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710077
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owners (The State and Road Development Authority), title classifications, and other land-specific particulars. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified for Type 4 classification.
